name: v14_seleval_smoke_win
purpose: TASKS 129 (16 Nov 2026, design note 13): the selection eval of one finished stage-1 checkpoint (c00_control, seed 0) on the platform read1 will run on. The WSL smoke of 12:5x (v14_seleval_smoke) passed the registry gate, made the eval in 333 s at a 1.94 GB peak and reproduced hold-out (a) to 1e-6, but 18 of the 169 selection molecules came out at 1e13-1e19: numpy's default pinv cutoff keeps a null singular value of the Wilson B on that Linux build (TASKS 236), which this Windows build drops. So the 0.001 reproduction and the seconds are measured here.

estimate.basis: the same command took 337 s in WSL on 16 Nov 2026 (v14_seleval_smoke), reading the corpus through /mnt/c

memory.basis: max RSS 1,941,428 kB of the same command in WSL on 16 Nov 2026 (v14_seleval_smoke's log), with a margin for the Windows build; beside v14_stage1's 7.7 GB that is 10.7 of 13
